title: JmapRequestBuilder::add_call does not explain what call_id is used for
description: request.rs JmapRequestBuilder::add_call (lines 50-56): doc says 'call_id must be unique within this request; callers use it to match responses back to the originating call' but does not explain the matching mechanism — that call_id appears verbatim in the response Invocation at index 2 and is the argument to extract_response(). A caller who does not read extract_response's doc will not know what format or value to use. Suggested fix: add a one-line example showing that the same string passed to add_call must be passed to extract_response.
